names: Squats day — front squat + upper, 9,670 kg

en.eNote: No meals logged for Aug 8 – Aug 14 (last intake log: Jun 14), so the energy and burn charts assume the 2,000 kcal plan. Garmin active burn averaged ~439 kcal/day, up from ~422 last window, peaking 941 on Monday's swim-plus-SUP day and 830 on Tuesday, with Thursday's gym session adding 629. Saturday (83 kcal) was a near-total rest day; today reads 17 so far, nothing recorded yet this morning.
en.bNote: Net exercise = Garmin active calories; standing BMR 2,414 (today's Garmin BMR reads 654 because the day is incomplete). Intake assumes 2,000 kcal all seven days (none logged after Jun 14), so the implied balance ≈ −853 kcal/day is exercise-driven, not measured. Friday (Aug 14) has barely started.
en.wNote: Bridge shows the last logged meals (Jun 12–14) — no intake was logged for the displayed week. Negative balance = deficit.
en.i1t: Strength is back — the fourteen-day gap closed on Thursday
en.i1: 7 sessions across 5 active days, 4h 18m and ~3,075 active kcal — against 8 sessions, 3h 51m and ~2,951 kcal in the Aug 7 – Aug 13 window. Fewer sessions but more time and more burn, and the reason is a single entry: Thursday's gym session, the first logged tonnage since Jul 30. The water work continues alongside it — two open-water swims totalling 2,286 m and four SUP paddles totalling 7,101 m. Swim volume is down from 3,323 m only because Friday's two short swims rolled off the back of the window; SUP distance is unchanged. Two days off: Saturday (83 active kcal, the quietest day of the vacation) and today, which has barely begun.
en.i2t: The session back: 9,670 kg, front squat capped at 80 kg
en.i2: Thursday 16:40 to 17:45 — 67 minutes, 603 kcal, avg 118 bpm and a max of 156, the highest heart rate of the window against Monday's 154. Sixteen sets, 165 reps, 9,670 kg across five exercises. Front squat led at 60×6, then 80×10, 80×6, 80×6 — a deliberately conservative top load for a first day back, and the right call. Lat pulldown ran 65, 65, 70 kg for 12s, chest press 65, 70, 70 with reps slipping 12/12/10, leg curl climbed 40/45/50, and the closing shoulder press faded hard: 40×12, 40×10, then 35×6. That last drop is the honest marker of where conditioning sits after two weeks off. Note the lift-HR chart did not move — front squat is not one of the three tracked lifts, so the trap-bar, hack-squat and goblet series still end at Jun 20, Jul 28 and Jun 11 respectively.
en.i3t: All streams clean — Hevy caught up and delivered the session
en.i3: Seven consecutive recorded nights with HRV on each and no empty slots on the chart. Hevy synced before this refresh and returned Thursday's workout in full, including per-set loads, so the volume figure is measured rather than estimated. Intervals.icu synced and added nothing. Garmin ran clean through this morning; last night's sleep landed at 06:05.
en.i4t: Recovery: the short night is the story, not the training
en.i4: Last night ran 5h 08m — 2h 13m under the 7h 21m average and the shortest of the window by more than an hour and a half — scoring 68, the window low. Deep sleep barely flinched at 100 minutes, one under the window high and 32% of a much shorter night; REM took the whole cut at 50 minutes against a 85–147 range on the other six nights. Efficiency held at 96% with 13 minutes awake. HRV is soft for a third straight night at 34, three under the 37 average, and RHR moved for the first time — 55, up 2 and at the top of its 53–55 band. Morning stress 26. Readiness 62, low. Bedtime, not load, explains it: lights out at 00:44 after an evening that ended in the gym at 17:45.
en.rec: The restart was well judged. Capping front squat at 80 kg after fourteen days off, and letting the accessories carry the volume, is exactly how to come back without paying for it all week — and the 603 kcal at an average of 118 bpm says it was a real session, not a token one. The shoulder press fade (40×12 down to 35×6) is the one honest read on conditioning; expect the next session to feel similar and do not chase the old numbers yet. Sleep is the actual constraint right now. A 5h 08m night, a third soft HRV reading and RHR up 2 all arrived together, and the cause is a 00:44 bedtime rather than accumulated load. An evening lift followed by a late night is the pattern to break, not the lift itself: if the gym stays in the late-afternoon slot, lights out still needs to land before 23:00. Today has nothing logged and readiness is 62 — take it easy or keep it to water work, then put the next strength day in on Saturday when the night behind it is better. When you do, bring one of the tracked lifts back in. Trap-bar has not been logged since Jun 20 and hack squat since Jul 28 at 185 kg, so the per-set HR chart has been blind for weeks; start hack squat at 150–160 kg and the series picks up where it left off. Next: sleep before 23:00 tonight, easy or rest today, tracked strength lift on Saturday.

en.foot2: plan: strength restart after 14 days off · rebuild toward trap-bar DL / hack squat · swim + SUP as easy aerobic

hr.eNote: Nema zabilježenih obroka za 8.–14.8. (zadnji unos: 14.6.), pa grafovi energije i potrošnje pretpostavljaju planskih 2.000 kcal. Garmin aktivna potrošnja prosj. ~439 kcal/dan, naviše s ~422 prethodnog prozora, vrhunac 941 u ponedjeljak (plivanje + SUP) i 830 u utorak, uz 629 od četvrtkove teretane. Subota (83 kcal) bila je gotovo potpuni odmor; danas pokazuje 17, jutros još ništa nije zabilježeno.
hr.bNote: Neto trening = Garmin aktivne kalorije; standardni BMR 2.414 (današnji Garminov BMR pokazuje 654 jer dan nije završen). Unos pretpostavlja 2.000 kcal svih sedam dana (ništa zabilježeno nakon 14.6.), pa je implicirana bilanca ≈ −853 kcal/dan posljedica treninga, ne mjerena. Petak (14.8.) tek je počeo.
hr.wNote: Most prikazuje zadnje zabilježene obroke (12.–14.6.) — za prikazani tjedan nema unosa. Negativna bilanca = deficit.
hr.i1t: Snaga se vratila — četrnaestodnevna pauza zatvorena je u četvrtak
hr.i1: 7 treninga kroz 5 aktivnih dana, 4h 18m i ~3.075 aktivnih kcal — naspram 8 treninga, 3h 51m i ~2.951 kcal u prozoru 7.–13.8. Manje treninga, ali više vremena i veća potrošnja, a razlog je jedan jedini zapis: četvrtkova teretana, prva zabilježena tonaža od 30.7. Rad u vodi ide uz to — dva plivanja na moru ukupno 2.286 m i četiri veslanja na SUP-u ukupno 7.101 m. Volumen plivanja pao je s 3.323 m samo zato što su petkova dva kratka plivanja ispala sa stražnjeg kraja prozora; SUP udaljenost je nepromijenjena. Dva dana odmora: subota (83 aktivne kcal, najmirniji dan godišnjeg) i danas, koji je tek počeo.
hr.i2t: Povratni trening: 9.670 kg, prednji čučanj ograničen na 80 kg
hr.i2: Četvrtak od 16:40 do 17:45 — 67 minuta, 603 kcal, prosjek 118 otkucaja i maksimum od 156, najviši puls u prozoru naspram ponedjeljkovih 154. Šesnaest serija, 165 ponavljanja, 9.670 kg kroz pet vježbi. Prednji čučanj je vodio s 60×6, pa 80×10, 80×6, 80×6 — namjerno konzervativna gornja težina za prvi dan povratka, i ispravna odluka. Povlačenje na lat mašini išlo je 65, 65, 70 kg po 12, potisak za prsa 65, 70, 70 uz pad ponavljanja 12/12/10, pregib potkoljenice rastao je 40/45/50, a zaključni potisak za ramena osjetno je popustio: 40×12, 40×10, pa 35×6. Taj zadnji pad iskren je pokazatelj gdje je kondicija nakon dva tjedna pauze. Napomena: graf pulsa po serijama nije se pomaknuo — prednji čučanj nije jedan od tri praćena podizanja, pa serije trap-bara, hack čučnja i goblet čučnja i dalje završavaju 20.6., 28.7. odnosno 11.6.
hr.i3t: Svi tokovi čisti — Hevy je stigao i isporučio trening
hr.i3: Sedam uzastopnih zabilježenih noći, HRV upisan na svakoj, bez praznih mjesta na grafu. Hevy je sinkroniziran prije ovog osvježavanja i vratio je četvrtkov trening u cijelosti, uključujući težine po serijama, pa je podatak o volumenu izmjeren, a ne procijenjen. Intervals.icu je sinkroniziran i nije dodao ništa. Garmin je radio čisto do jutros; sinoćnji san stigao je u 06:05.
hr.i4t: Oporavak: priča je kratka noć, ne trening
hr.i4: Sinoć je noć trajala 5h 08m — 2h 13m ispod prosjeka od 7h 21m i najkraća u prozoru za više od sat i pol — uz ocjenu 68, minimum prozora. Duboki san jedva je zadrhtao sa 100 minuta, jedna ispod vrhunca prozora i 32% znatno kraće noći; REM je podnio cijeli rez sa 50 minuta naspram raspona 85–147 u ostalih šest noći. Učinkovitost je ostala 96% uz 13 minuta budnosti. HRV je mlak treću noć zaredom na 34, tri ispod prosjeka od 37, a RHR se prvi put pomaknuo — 55, dva više i na vrhu svog raspona 53–55. Jutarnji stres 26. Spremnost 62, niska. Objašnjenje je lijeganje, ne opterećenje: gašenje svjetla u 00:44 nakon večeri koja je u teretani završila u 17:45.
hr.rec: Povratak je dobro odmjeren. Ograničiti prednji čučanj na 80 kg nakon četrnaest dana pauze i pustiti da volumen nose pomoćne vježbe točno je način da se vratiš bez plaćanja cijeloga tjedna — a 603 kcal uz prosjek od 118 otkucaja govori da je bio pravi trening, a ne simboličan. Pad na potisku za ramena (40×12 do 35×6) jedino je iskreno očitanje kondicije; očekuj da će sljedeći trening biti sličan i ne juri stare brojke još. Pravo ograničenje trenutačno je san. Noć od 5h 08m, treće mlako HRV očitanje i RHR viši za dva stigli su zajedno, a uzrok je lijeganje u 00:44, ne nakupljeno opterećenje. Obrazac koji treba prekinuti je večernji trening praćen kasnom noći, a ne sam trening: ako teretana ostaje u kasnom poslijepodnevnom terminu, gašenje svjetla i dalje mora pasti prije 23:00. Danas nema ničega zabilježenog, a spremnost je 62 — uzmi lagano ili ostani na vodi, pa sljedeći dan snage stavi u subotu, kad je noć iza njega bolja. Kad to napraviš, vrati jedno od praćenih podizanja. Trap-bar nije zabilježen od 20.6., a hack čučanj od 28.7. na 185 kg, pa je graf pulsa po serijama tjednima slijep; kreni s hack čučnjem na 150–160 kg i niz se nastavlja gdje je stao. Sljedeće: večeras spavanje prije 23:00, danas lagano ili odmor, praćeno podizanje snage u subotu.
